title: IELTS Mock Test 2025 January Writing Practice Test 2
rules: Stay in full-screen mode until you submit the exam.

tasks.title: Task 1
tasks.heading: Writing Task 1
tasks.summary: Complete Task 1 in at least 150 words.
promptParagraphs: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task. The chart below shows the number of girls per 100 boys enrolled in different levels of school education.
Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
You should write at least 150 words.

tasks.title: Task 2
tasks.heading: Writing Task 2
tasks.summary: Complete Task 2 in at least 250 words.
promptParagraphs: You should spend about 40 minutes on this task. Some people believe that capital punishment should not be used. Others, however, argue that it should be allowed for the most serious crimes. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
You should write at least 250 words.
